# The Planets That Keep Their Course

## Scripture

**"He is the radiance of the glory of God and the exact imprint of his nature, and he upholds the universe by the word of his power." — Hebrews 1:3 (ESV)**

## Reflection

Step outside on a clear October evening, and you may notice something steady: planets. Unlike the stars, which seem fixed in their constellations, planets wander slowly night by night. Yet their wandering is no chaos—it follows an orbit appointed before the first dawn. Jupiter rises on schedule. Saturn keeps its patient circuit. Nothing drifts.

Here is a picture of God's sustaining hand. Hebrews tells us that Christ "upholds the universe by the word of his power." The same voice that spoke light into being keeps every planet in its path—and keeps you in yours.

Perhaps this season finds you feeling unmoored, your days wandering without a clear course. Remember: the God who holds Jupiter in its orbit holds your life too. Your path may not look like anyone else's. It may curve through waiting, through loss, through unexpected turns. But it is not random. The One who numbers the stars also orders your steps.

The planets remind us that faithfulness is not frantic. They simply keep moving, trusting the gravity of their Maker. Tonight, let their quiet constancy preach to your heart: the God who keeps creation steady will keep you.

## Prayer

Lord, when my life feels aimless, remind me that You hold all things together by Your powerful word. Thank You for the steady witness of the planets, orbiting in Your care. Keep me faithful in the path You've set before me, trusting that the One who guides the heavens guides me too. In Jesus' name, Amen.
